note: Source of truth for the plan. Agents: read AGENTS.md, and change status only through scripts/plan.mjs. size: 1 = up to a week, 2 = one to two weeks, 3 = two to three weeks. placeholder: true means the spec is not written yet, so the task cannot be claimed. Every task needs docs/qa/<ID>.md (independent QA criteria) before it can be claimed; see docs/qa/README.md. version: the release a task belongs to (D45, docs/ROADMAP.md); a task may depend only on its own or an earlier version.

tasks.done_when: Per §8.3 (Milo stage) and D48: the tracker computes Milo's knowledge (mastered ideas + 3 × units whose latest teachback.judged is pass) and stage (1 Curious newbie at 0, 2 Getting it at 3, 3 Thinker at 7, 4 Scholar at 12) in rulesVersion 2, shared with M8, as pure deterministic replay with property tests; it's in the student view, and rulesVersion 1 outputs are unchanged

tasks.title: Milo character: Soul file, skills and guardrails
tasks.done_when: Per D48 and D13: the built-in Milo in packages/ai is a Soul file (identity, voice, values, boundaries), skills (the teach-back answer checker with a structured verdict per key point, plus reactions to his stage) and guardrails (A2's fixed ones plus never giving answers away); Milo's context holds only the student's own tracker outputs (stage, unit, mastered ideas), never teacher-only signals or names; persona overrides change only his name and personality wording; A5 eval cases cover his voice and guardrails per grade band

tasks.title: Teach Milo: the end-of-unit teach-back
tasks.done_when: Per §8.2, §8.3 and D48: when every idea in a unit is mastered, the student teaches Milo the unit's approved assessment questions; Milo's checker judges each answer, the output is stored with ai.output_shown, and teachback.done (typed text in InteractionText, anonymised by A7) and teachback.judged (pass or retry, with key points hit) are recorded; the student sees Milo's reaction and what was missing; unit completion and Milo's stage come from the tracker; a teacher can reopen a teach-back only by choice (§7)

tasks.title: Core-only unlocks (rulesVersion 2)
tasks.done_when: Per D49 and §8.3: in rulesVersion 2 a core idea unlocks when its core-scope requires are mastered; prerequisite-scope requires never lock it; packs without scope behave as before. The domain's lockStates and mapStates apply the same rule at zero progress, and §8.4 rule 5's agreement property test covers it. Pure deterministic replay; rulesVersion 1 unchanged

versions.name: Pilot (MVP)
versions.goal: Everything the app can't live without: the Water Cycle and Kinematics pilot (D42, D44) with grounded tutoring, explained and challengeable feedback, fairness safeguards, the anonymous layer, the two-layer trace-back and the student map

versions.name: AI design principles
versions.goal: How the AI reasons and teaches: bounded context from anonymised memory summaries, metacognition (students critique AI output; graded hints, delays and reflection), interests, the study planner, isolated model sandboxes, and model research

versions.name: Visuals and motivation
versions.goal: The student experience: Milo's avatar, cards and combos, map light-up and rewards, levels and perks, sandbox exploration, relational examples and productive struggle

versions.name: Curriculum building
versions.goal: Authoring tools: Atlas as the editing interface, drafting from teacher uploads, prerequisite editing, the persona editor, self-hosted video (X2), Drive import and research export
